claims.claim: The studied response modifies selected target coordinates by a common fraction of remaining headroom, fixes rivals, and counts support rather than training cost.
Evaluated headroom fractions are one quarter, one half, and full headroom; strict first place requires a margin exceeding 1e-10.
The median averages the central pair on even panels; symmetric trimming removes floor(m/5) values from each tail.
The primary panels have 57 HELM subjects and six Open LLM task coordinates; the separate BBH sensitivity uses 24 recorded subtasks.
The public score inputs are the pinned HELM release, contents revision, and distinct results revision acquired on the recorded date, with the reported extracted-record checksum.

The pinned official Open LLM contents dataset card lists six Raw fields (IFEval, BBH, MATH level 5, GPQA, MUSR, MMLU-PRO), separately from parallel display-score fields; the analyzed inputs use the raw fields.
The protocol samples one nonleading target in each of 24 score strata using seeds 1009, 1013, and 1019, paired across aggregation rules and ceilings.
Full-support failure certifies unattainability for these monotone aggregators; it is not merely a limited-search failure.
The selected implementation enumerates supports up to six coordinates, solves larger means exactly by sorted headroom, and uses marginal greedy witnesses for larger order-statistic panels.
Lower bounds are independently verified reference bounds; feasible large-panel order-statistic supports are upper bounds, not exact costs.
The fixed jointly attainable mean-median cohorts contain 18, 17, and 17 targets, and every cost included in their contrast is exact.

In each fixed six-task cohort the average median-minus-mean support fraction is negative at half headroom and positive at full headroom; all reported values and abstract ranges are derived from the same exact contrasts.
The primary grid contains 72 target decisions per rule-ceiling cell, not necessarily independent unique models.
Open LLM attainment counts at quarter, half, and full headroom differ across mean, median, and trimming as reported in the main text and complete grid.
HELM attainment counts at quarter, half, and full headroom are those in the main text and complete grid; all ordinary primary nonattainment is certified infeasible.
All primary targets attain first place at full headroom in the recorded panels.
Figure 3 certification intervals use equal seed weights and within-ceiling three-rule joint cohorts; the caption reports all cohort sizes.

HELM half-headroom order-statistic average upper bounds lie below the exact mean cost on the joint cohort, while full-headroom intervals overlap the mean and do not establish reversal of minimum costs.
The reported six-task three-rule support averages are exact within their declared jointly attainable ceiling-specific cohorts, which differ across ceilings.
The main half-headroom table reports all-target penalized effort for exact/witness, marginal greedy, random, and no-intervention policies; nonattainment contributes one.
The frozen procedure ties greedy on HELM and the six-task mean, and has smaller penalized effort on the six-task median and trimmed mean at half headroom.
Every scalar in the complete primary table is reproduced from the ordinary primary evaluator decisions, with success and penalty semantics kept separate.
Recorded conditional paired policy intervals use 200 cluster bootstrap resamples, RNG seed 48271, and 95-percent percentile endpoints; these do not test cross-rule ordering.
Every row of the supplementary policy interval table reproduces the recorded family, rule, ceiling, seed, comparator, difference, and interval endpoints.
Auxiliary HELM projections, Open LLM even slots, and BBH odd slots have separately reported counts; BBH revision matching does not establish identical evaluation settings.
The completed final evaluation is qualified; this does not imply unrestricted validity or exact large-panel order-statistic costs.
The recorded final control pass fraction is one; candidate diagnostics remain unverified.
The retained selection is the reference baseline, with no qualifying development winner and zero retained development-score change.
Three development alternatives were scored and none unscored; their qualification-failure causes are not identified, and they are not controlled component ablations.
The reported source locations support the exact evaluated implementation, whose selected and baseline source copies match.
The final evaluator uses CPU computation, its documented wall and method reservations and advisory decision budget; dependency versions are the supplied versions.
Raw-score documentation, normalization, content partitioning, and uncertain score-data redistribution rights are as recorded by the acquisition manifest.
The study does not measure training responses, practical expenditure, causal contamination effects, or population superiority; the observed ordering is conditional and descriptively selected.
